_how: Twenty review renders were opened and read by eye on 2026-09-24 before this was reported (Claude, not a radiologist): ten of the fourteen two-labeller L6 rows, all three two-labeller T13 rows, two two-labeller four-lumbar rows, and the five calls named from the SPINEPS ctd before this screen, plus two unresolved rows. What each render shows is written below as seen; it changes no row. Where the text names a TS label it is TotalSegmentator's own name for the body, read off the render's grey labels and the case json.
TS_s1089: 12 rib pairs down to TS T12, then six free bodies (f1-f6) above an ordinary sacrum. TS's own masks name an L6; VERIDAH names L1-L6. C2 to the sacrum in the field. Looks like a true six-free-lumbar spine (TS12_VERIFY agrees).
TS_s0059: Same pattern from C7 down: rib_12 on TS T12, six free bodies, TS names L6, VERIDAH L1-L6. Credible L6.
TS_s0446: Same pattern from C7 down, TS names L6, VERIDAH L1-L6. Credible L6.
TS_s0733: Same pattern from C7 down, TS names L6, VERIDAH L1-L6. Credible L6.
TS_s0077: Field starts at T9 (T1 not seen). rib_12 on TS T12, six free bodies, TS names L6, VERIDAH L1-L6; the v201 masks of the same CT read five. Consistent L6, but nothing in the field fixes the thoracic count.
TS_s0049: TS's L3 label covers two bodies (1.9x its neighbours' height) and B split it; six free bodies; VERIDAH independently names L1-L6. Consistent L6 whose sixth body TS merged into one label. The split is the weak link: on CTSpinoPelvic1K the split rule was right and wrong about equally often.
TS_s0158: Field starts at T10. TS's rib_12 attaches to the body TS names T11 and TS's T12 has no rib, so TS's rib numbering and vertebra naming disagree by one. Six free bodies. If TS's rib count is right this is 12 + 6 (L6); if its vertebra names are right the spine is ordinary with the 12th rib one level high. Not decidable without T1.
TS_s0477: Rods and pedicle screws span the thoracolumbar junction. TS T11 carries rib 11, TS T12 carries no rib (none in the TS masks), VERIDAH jumps from T11 to L1. 11 rib-bearing counted from the top plus 6 free = an ordinary 24 presacral bodies. The two labellers agree because both see the same missing 12th rib under hardware: the agreement is not independent here. Most likely an ordinary spine; needs a reader.
TS_s0683: Field starts at T9. TS T11 carries rib 11, TS T12 rib-less, six free bodies; VERIDAH L1-L6. L6 by the rib convention; with T1 out of the field it may equally be an ordinary spine with a rib-less T12.
TS_s1974: Poor image (arms down, lines and leads). 11 rib-bearing bodies counted from C7 plus 6 free = 24 presacral: an ordinary count with a rib-less T12, L6 by the rib convention only (the row's note says so).
TS_s0616: 13 rib pairs, the 13th pair 69-71 mm on both sides and meeting the 20th body; five free bodies; C2 to the sacrum in the field. Credible T13 (TS12_VERIFY agrees).
TS_s1023: Chest CT ending at L2-L3, no sacrum. The 13th rib-bearing body carries one 39 mm rib on the right only. T13 by rib contact, an L1 with a rudimentary rib by VerSe's 38 mm rule; the lumbar count is impossible here. Weak T13.
TS_s1329: Chest CT ending at L3-L4, no sacrum. The 13th body carries one 36 mm rib on the left only. By VerSe's 38 mm rule this is a lumbar vertebra with a rudimentary rib, not a T13. Weak T13.
TS_s0436: 12 rib pairs (short 12th ribs), four free bodies, then a large sacrum; TS's own masks also name only L1-L4. Four-lumbar by count; sacralised L5 inside the sacrum label versus a true four-lumbar spine is open (no Castellvi read).
TS_s0171: 12 rib pairs, four free bodies above the sacrum, TS names L1-L4; CT rib-shaped bone flagged beside L4's transverse processes. Four-lumbar by count; sacralisation versus four-lumbar open.
TS_s1178: Scoliosis. B: 12 rib pairs and 5 free bodies. VERIDAH jumps from T11 to L1 (skips T12), so its L6 is B's L5: the ctd's L6 is a VERIDAH naming error (TS12_VERIFY said the same). Registry row: unresolved.
TS_s1088: TS's T1 label holds two bodies, so TS's thoracic names run one short; 12 rib pairs; the 20th body is rib-less; six free bodies. L6 by the rib convention (TS12_VERIFY: 7/12/6); VERIDAH names the rib-less 20th body T13. Registry row: unresolved.
TS_s1123: 12 rib pairs; the 20th body carries 28 mm of rib-shaped bone on the left that is not a TS rib, the likely reason VERIDAH names it T13. The field ends in the upper sacrum and TS's sacrum label holds a free body, so the lumbosacral count is cut (TS12_VERIFY read six free there). T13 refuted by the rib count; L6 not countable by rule.
TS_s0016: Field starts at T10. TS names six lumbar (L1-L6) below the lowest rib-bearing body; VERIDAH calls the first free body a rib-less T12 and counts five. With T1 out of the field nobody can count the total. Registry row: unresolved.
TS_s0086: C7 to the sacrum in the field, 12 rib pairs; the 20th body has a small rib-like fragment on one side that B does not attach; VERIDAH names it T13, B counts six free; TS's rib_12 sits on the body TS names T11. T13 with a rudimentary rib versus L6: a reader's call. Registry row: unresolved.
_tally: Of the ten two-labeller L6 renders looked at: five look like true six-free spines on which TotalSegmentator's own annotators also named an L6 (s1089, s0059, s0446, s0733, s0077); one rests on a TS label B split (s0049); four rest on a TS T12 without a rib or on TS rib/vertebra numbering that disagree (s0158, s0477, s0683, s1974), and two of those count 11 rib-bearing from the top, an ordinary 24 presacral bodies. Of the three two-labeller T13: one credible (s0616), two resting on a single short 13th rib with no sacrum in the field (s1023, s1329). The TS-names-L6 kind is the one to trust first; the rib-less-T12 kind is L6 only by the rib convention and needs the thoracic count.
